entries.raw: Supplementary Material This appendix includes additional experimental results, detailed hyperparameter settings (optimizer: Adam with learning rate 3e-5; weight decay of 0.01; batch size: 32), extended ablation studies, and further analysis of the negative generation process. Also included is the domain-specific perturbation analysis (originally Figure 4), which confirms that single-domain and multi-domain training yield nearly identical trajectories in F1 scores and loss curves. Extra plots, error bars, and confidence interval details are provided to aid reproducibility.
